originalInput.name: Research tool pilot
originalInput.goal: Balance hands-on qualitative and quantitative research practice.

groups.name: Qualitative practice
groups.description: Conducting user interviews, field observations, moderated usability sessions and thematic analysis of qualitative transcripts.

groups.name: Quantitative practice
groups.description: Analyzing numerical survey data, statistical experiments, dashboards, quantitative metrics and regression models.

candidates.bio: I do not conduct qualitative interviews or thematic analysis. I have no research experience.
I repair bicycles and bake bread. No research experience.
I conduct ethnographic field studies and write qualitative research findings.
I facilitate in-depth interviews and thematic analysis.
I build statistical models from survey results and numerical data.
I analyze A/B experiments, conversion rates and quantitative metrics.
I create analytics dashboards and calculate regression coefficients.
I use statistical tests to compare numeric survey responses.
